prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Graphite and Aqua: page #F7FBFC, text #233338, accent #006C78, secondary surface #C9F0ED, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Work Sans; condensed heading with open sans text. Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Use body 18px, heading 64px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
